thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - gpu-node-22 is flapping. Multiple containers crashed with CUDA OOMs. Paging spike detected in kv-cache and paged-attention allocator. Auto-evict triggered. Created incident #inc-712345. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/kv-paging

Vivian: taking first oncall for this. I'll start triage.

Ashley: ack - I'm with infra on node isolation.

Mike: seeing a sharp rise in 5xx and 95th latency on hosted routes (token gen). Top trace shows repeated retries + timeouts.

Vivian: quick inventory -> `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide | grep gpu-node-22` shows 6 pods impacted, restarts=3-7 each.

Vivian: pulled allocator logs from one crashed pod: ```[2026-03-17T11:33:21Z] paged_alloc WARN: fragmentation_ratio=0.72, free_runs=8, slow_drift=1.2MB/s
[2026-03-17T11:33:28Z] kv_cache ERROR: stale_pages=482 -> allocation_failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T11:33:28Z] runtime ERROR: container exit code 137 (OOM)```

Sourav: copying node dmesg -> `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, pid=9876` — classic GPU OOM traces.

infra-bot: cordoning node gpu-node-22 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-22` and kicking drain. Evicting non-critical daemons.

Ashley: started canary patch to disable attention paging for the problematic model group (env ATTENTION_PAGING=false) on 3 pods. Command: `kubectl set env deployment/serving-llm-small -n redwood-serving ATTENTION_PAGING=false --record`

Mike: also lowered batch_size from 8 -> 1 on the canary via feature-flag rollout to reduce peak memory.

Vivian: applied a runtime KV eviction override on the canary: `KV_EVICT_RATIO=0.35` to force earlier reclamation. Watching memory graphs.

Vivian: running compact job against kv-cache on drained node: ```/opt/redwood/bin/kv-compact --node gpu-node-22 --force
kv-compact: scanned 1.2M slots, reclaimed 142MB contiguous slabs, compaction_rounds=3
kv-compact: fragmentation_ratio -> 0.45```

Ashley: canary pods returned healthy after changes. No new OOMs in canary for 6m. Rolling these env changes to remaining pods on the node.

Vivian: note — we still see slow leak on older allocator instances. Root cause hypothesis: free-list fragmentation + slow orphaned KV entries under high prefix variance.

Mike: customer impact check: between 11:34-11:42 UTC ~12% of requests to hosted-api returned 503/504. Upstream errors concentrated on a small subset of customers; highest impact: AcmeCo (6% of their calls). Inform SRE and CS.

Sourav: notified CS (pager duty) and flagged AcmeCo for follow-up.

infra-bot: node gpu-node-22 drained and cordoned. Pods moved to other nodes; those nodes saw slight latency bump but remained healthy.

Vivian: mitigation summary so far: 1) cordoned/drained node 2) disabled attention paging (canary -> roll) 3) lowered batch size for affected model 4) bumped KV eviction ratio and ran compaction 5) restarted crashed containers post-drain.

Mike: short term ask: keep ATTENTION_PAGING disabled for 2 hours, monitor error rate and token-level latency. If stable, we'll keep until allocator patch lands.

Ashley: rolling restart scheduled for remaining pods on other nodes in 30m to pick up eviction config. Using canary windows.

Vivian: planned next steps: collect heap/kv-map dumps from a few pre-patch pods, reproduce in staging with synthetic prefix variance, land allocator free-run merging fix (PR ready, needs CI): https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4182.

Sourav: CS note drafted: "We experienced transient increased errors for a subset of hosted requests due to GPU memory exhaustion on a single node. Root cause: allocator fragmentation under high prefix variance; mitigations applied. No data loss. Follow-up report to customers in next 24h."

Vivian: monitoring shows error-rate back to baseline after roll; 95th latency down from +1.2s spike to +120ms over baseline.

infra-bot: marking automated incident state -> MITIGATED when stable for 20m. Current stable timer: 8m.

Mike: filing postmortem and tagging eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml. Assigning Vivian to lead immediate RCA.

Ashley: thumbs-up :white_check_mark: — I'll coordinate the rolling restart and keep CS informed.

Vivian: leaving oncall notes: reclaimed slabs + forced compaction avoided immediate OOMs; long term we need allocator coalescing and smarter KV TTL under prefix spikes. Will follow up with PR/benchmarks.

oncall-bot: Incident #inc-712345 status changed -> MITIGATED (tentative) — see thread for mitigation details.

Vivian: closing handoff — handing to next shift for long-term follow-up.
